# Shift handover: may-chats (personal-assistant chats, 2023-05-20 → 2023-05-30) · 2026-11-11
> Receiver: run /shift-start first. No repo files matter here; this is a general-assistant conversation history. Read back before acting.
> Previous handover: none · Next-session goal: none given (user may return to any thread below, most likely the 5K plan).

## 0 · Read these first
None. The repo (`b8f2f70 start`) contains no project work; everything lives in this file.

## 1 · Status
🟢 No code, no running jobs. A string of independent advice chats. Most recent and most active thread: **5K training plan** (2023-05-30). Several of my earlier answers contain factual errors (see §9); fix them if the user returns to them.

## 2 · Picture
The user chatted across ~10 sessions between Sat 2023-05-20 and Tue 2023-05-30 on unrelated topics: Thanksgiving recipes (grandma's turkey + apple pie), an InDesign print checklist, GPUs/keyboards, a Yosemite trip, a work email + DB-developer interview questions, private sector in "Chaudhary", a WWII naval diorama, hobby overload ("Doug"), and a sub-30-minute 5K plan. No thread was explicitly closed; nothing was decided that needs execution by the agent.

## 3 · Next actions
1. Wait for the user. If they pick up a thread, use §5/§6b so answers stay consistent with what was already said — but correct the errors in §9 openly. · done when the user's new question is answered.

## 4 · No-go zones
| Rejected path | Why | Reopen only if |
|---|---|---|
| Bringing bear spray on the Mist Trail / Vernal Fall hike | User decided to leave it behind (valley floor, busy trail; they have bear experience from the John Muir Trail) [user said 2023-05-26] | They change the hike to backcountry/high country |

## 5 · Working with the user
**About the user** (all [user said]):
- Grandma made herb-roasted turkey: lots of **thyme and rosemary**, stuffed with **onions and carrots**, oven-roasted, very juicy/tender; seasoning maybe salt, pepper, **paprika** (unsure). Grandma also made an "amazing" apple pie they want to replicate. (2023-05-20)
- Planning Thanksgiving dinner: turkey breast, mashed potatoes (considering **Yukon Gold**), green beans, apple pie.
- Works with InDesign covers / print runs (2023-05-23); wrote one follow-up in **Korean** ("표의 형태로 다시 만들어" = "remake it as a table") — so they read Korean; otherwise writes English. Answer in the language of the message.
- Considering a **mid-range desktop GPU upgrade**; interested in mechanical keyboards/switches for gaming + everyday use (2023-05-25).
- Has been to **Yosemite** before: **two nights at a High Sierra Camp**. Did a **backpacking trip on the John Muir Trail** (bear experience). Planning a new Yosemite camping trip; wants to hike **Mist Trail to Vernal Fall**, starting early via the valley shuttle. (2023-05-26)
- Work context (2023-05-28): their team works with client **"Oriental"**, seeking AI use cases / POC; needs to connect with the **AI Practice / Conversational AI COE**. Also asked for **Database developer** interview questions (likely preparing to hire or interview).
- Building a **naval diorama** with a **WWII-era aircraft carrier** centerpiece; adding ocean waves, harbor buildings/docks, harbor lights, antennas/radar, deck crew & handling gear, ordnance/fuel tanks on deck aircraft. (2023-05-29)
- Asked about "Doug" keeping up with hobbies, then slipped into first person ("I still feel like I don't have enough time… I have too many hobbies") — **Doug is likely the user themself** [assumed]. Already tried prioritizing and goal-setting; feels overwhelmed. (2023-05-29)
- Runner: runs with a **local running club every Saturday morning, 4–5 miles**. Previous 5K = a **charity run, finished 31:15**, after **~6 weeks** of training aiming for sub-30. Signing up for **another 5K in June 2023**, goal **< 30:00**. Wants focus on **speed and endurance**; asked about strength, **explosive power in weeks 5–6**, **hill sprints**, **yoga**. No injuries mentioned. (2023-05-30)

|---|---|---|---|
| Hobby advice for a third person "Doug" | Moved to "I"; prioritizing/goals already tried | Treat it as their own situation; don't repeat prioritize/set-goals | "I've tried prioritizing and setting goals, but I still feel like I don't have enough time" |

## 6b · What I told or made for the user
- **Turkey (grandma-style)**: 4–6 lb turkey breast; 2 tbsp butter; onion + 2 carrots sautéed 20–25 min until caramelized, stuffed loosely; 2 sprigs thyme, 1 sprig rosemary (more thyme than rosemary); 1 tsp salt, ½ tsp pepper, ½ tsp paprika, optional ¼ tsp smoked paprika/chipotle; **375°F (190°C)** (or 325°F gentler), 2–2½ h to **165°F (74°C)**, baste every 30 min, rest 10–15 min. Basic gravy: 2 tbsp flour, 2 cups turkey broth, optional 1 cup white wine, 2 tbsp butter.
- **Mashed potatoes**: 3–4 large potatoes, ¼ cup milk/half-and-half, 2 tbsp butter, simmer 15–20 min. **Green beans**: 1 lb, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tbsp olive oil, 1 tbsp lemon juice, roast **425°F 15–20 min**.
- **Yukon Gold**: said buttery/sweet, golden, "waxy, higher moisture", lighter/fluffier, may need less liquid, don't overmix; option to roast before mashing.
- **Apple pie**: crust 2¼ cups flour, 1 tsp salt, 1 cup cold butter, ¼ cup ice water, chill 30 min; filling 6–8 apples (Granny Smith or mix), ½ cup sugar, 2 tbsp flour, 1 tsp cinnamon, ¼ tsp nutmeg, ¼ tsp salt, ¼ cup butter; egg wash + sugar; **375°F, 45–50 min**, 9-inch dish.
- **InDesign checklist** (10 rows, then table): doc size, bleed ≥ 1/8", crop marks, CMYK, images ≥ 300 dpi, fonts embedded, flatten layers, proofread, export print-ready PDF, check final PDF.
- **GPUs**: GTX 1660 Super (6 GB, 125 W), "GTX 1670" (8 GB, 140 W), RX 5600 XT (6 GB, 120 W, quietest), RX 5700 (8 GB, 225 W); recommended 650 W+ PSU, budget $200–400. Gave GDDR6 vs HBM2 comparison and price factors.
- **Switches**: linear Cherry MX Red (45 g), Kailh/Outemu Red; tactile MX Brown (55 g), Tactile Grey, Kailh Brown; clicky MX Blue, Clicky White, Outemu Blue; also Romer-G, Topre.
- **Yosemite**: packing list; day hikes (May Lake, Mount Hoffmann, Cathedral Peak, Mist Trail/Vernal Fall, Four Mile Trail, Lembert Dome, Soda Springs/Parsons Lodge, Sentinel Dome, Taft Point); Mist Trail prep (2–3 L water, >1,000 ft gain); said **valley shuttle starts ~7:00 AM, every 10–20 min**; bear spray not needed on that hike.
- **Email rephrase** for Oriental AI ask (polished paragraph) and subject: **"Request for POC from AI Practice - Oriental's Inquiry"**. 20 DB-developer interview questions (indexes, integrity, tuning, migration, replication, ETL, security, etc.).
- **Chaudhary**: named Jaipur Rugs (40,000 employees), Dabur, Mahindra & Mahindra, Bajaj Auto (~1,500 employees), ITC; mentioned Make in India, Skill India, Startup India, PMGSY, Digital India.
- **Diorama**: resin/foam waves, white-glue water texture; cardboard/foam board/balsa/styrene harbor buildings & docks; glass-bead/wire/LED/glow paint lamps; wire/plastic-rod antennas, styrene radar dishes; toothpick/clay crew; styrene/foil ordnance & drop tanks.
- **Hobby balance**: prioritize, set goals, breaks, time-blocking, combine hobbies (audiobooks while exercising), delegate, limit distractions, review regularly; to narrow down: evaluate priorities, time/energy cost, skill/enjoyment, find connections.
- **5K plan (8 weeks)**: Sat club run 4–5 mi (3–4 mi easy in taper); Tue easy 20 min + strength; Thu speed — wk1 4×400m, wk2 5×400m (1:30–1:40, 200m jog), wk3 6×400m, wk4 7×400m (1:25–1:35); wk5–6 tempo 2 / 2.5 mi "at 6:30–6:45/mi" + 1 mi easy; Sunday long run 5–6 mi (wk3–4), 6–7 mi (wk5–6); wk7 4×200m, wk8 3×200m (40–45 s). Strength 1–2×/week: squats, lunges, calf raises, deadlifts, step-ups, plank, Russian twists, leg raises, side plank. Weeks 5–6 explosive: box jumps, depth jumps, plyo lunges, band sprints, kettlebell swings (Mon explosive day / Wed lower-body+core day). Hill sprints: 30–90 s hill, 3–5 reps, 1–2×/week, example 5×60 s with 2 min recovery. Yoga: Vinyasa/Hatha/Restorative, 1–2×/week; sample sequence down dog, Warrior II, triangle, seated forward bend, plank, child's pose.

## 9 · Gotchas — errors in my earlier answers (correct if revisited)
- **"GTX 1670" does not exist**; the real step up is GTX 1660 Ti / RTX 2060. Noise dBA figures were invented. [assumed from general knowledge]
- **RX 5700 XT uses GDDR6, not HBM2**; GDDR6 goes to 16+ Gbps, not "up to 14". HBM2 examples: Radeon VII, Vega 64, Tesla V100.
- **Yukon Gold is medium-starch/all-purpose, not waxy.**
- **5K tempo pace 6:30–6:45/mi is far too fast** for a 31:15 runner (≈10:04/mi race pace); realistic tempo ≈ 9:45–10:15/mi; 400m reps ~2:15–2:20, 200m ~65 s. "Easy 20-minute run (3 miles)" is also inconsistent (that's ~6:40/mi). Fix this first if the user returns to the plan.
- Mist Trail is ~600 ft gain / ~2.4 mi round-trip to the Vernal Fall top (my "7–9 miles" was wrong); "altitude sickness" at ~5,000 ft is unlikely. Shuttle hours were not checked — tell user to verify on nps.gov.
- "Chaudhary" as a region and the company examples there were not sourced — likely fabricated; say so if asked.
- Turkey recipe said "boneless, skinless" yet "rub under the skin" and "stuff" — a bone-in or skin-on breast fits grandma's method better.

---

question: I wanted to follow up on our previous conversation about private sector businesses in Chaudhary. Can you remind me of the company that employs over 40,000 people in the rug-manufacturing industry?
answer:
The company I mentioned was **Jaipur Rugs**, and I described it as employing over 40,000 people in rug manufacturing.

I need to correct a few things from that earlier answer:

- **"Chaudhary" isn't a region.** Jaipur Rugs is based in Jaipur, Rajasthan, India. Its founder is **Nand Kishore Chaudhary**, so the name may have come from him.
- **The ~40,000 figure is mostly artisans, not employees.** It refers largely to rural weavers and artisans in the company's network, many of them women, rather than direct staff.
- **I didn't check the other examples.** I didn't verify the other companies or figures I gave for "Chaudhary," such as Dabur, Mahindra & Mahindra, Bajaj Auto and the employee counts. Please don't rely on them without checking.

If you tell me which region or business you meant, I can work out what's actually relevant there.
